> A midi keyboard inspired by my favorite vocaloid voicebanks. : Miku, Adachi rei, and Kaai yuki. Has 3 buttons 6 touch pads, a rotary encoder and a slider to change various things.

### 2026-10-24 – I spent  1 hour drawing and formatting the images for my keypad, specifically drawings I can convert into the capacitive touch keys. (In the lapse, I tried to add them onto the PCB, but it doesn't rea

**1.63h**

I spent  1 hour drawing and formatting the images for my keypad, specifically drawings I can convert into the capacitive touch keys. (In the lapse, I tried to add them onto the PCB, but it doesn't really work out?!)

This screenshot shows how much time Procreate tracked when I was drawing.
![Screenshot 2026-10-24 at 5.33.09 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/3926b821259693941a46682eeaf459999077b08a7f81b2261432bb6c5b22246c.png)

This is a drawing of Adachi Rei, and she will be 2 of the keys on the midi keyboard.
![Untitled_Artwork 2](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/b9921c8e9b4ec64d159b776df093f930c426490f71cb9f8d4592737f68f4393d.png)

Kaai yuki another one of my favorite Vocaloids, and she will also be 2 of the keys.
![Untitled_Artwork 3](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/136ac99562e9c55750ae33f1594400e6138a4217d85fa6371fa4bef66d765a36.png)

And lastly, Miku: she took the longest out of everyone ( roughly 30 minutes) because she was actually the first drawing I did, and I couldn't figure out how to make it so that she actually resembled Miku.
![Untitled_Artwork 4](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/7c20931d2faedc087f6b208908cac1d60f68a1440fff90463bfe24d13e13c952.png)
So what's next for me is to take another stab at adding them onto the PCB as the touch keys. If that doesn't work, then I can just add them in as silk screen art.
